Snowflake Data Engineer – Cortex AI

Location: Nashville, TN
Employment type: Contract
Indicative rate: $40–$50/hr

Develop and maintain Snowflake data solutions, including databases, schemas, warehouses, and related objects. Build dependable data pipelines, transformations, and integrations that turn business and technical requirements into maintainable implementations. Support production workloads by reviewing and optimizing SQL, troubleshooting issues, and improving performance and reliability. Apply Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities to approved use cases where appropriate.

Hands-on experience developing and maintaining Snowflake data solutions.
Strong SQL skills, including query development and optimization.
Experience working with Snowflake databases, schemas, and warehouses.
Experience building data pipelines and transformation workflows.
Ability to translate functional and technical requirements into maintainable solutions.
Experience supporting production data workloads and troubleshooting issues.
Ability to consider performance, reliability, and cost in Snowflake implementations.
Preferred qualifications
Experience building or supporting workloads with Snowflake Cortex AI.
